goal: Allow importing descriptors without private keys into wallets that already hold the keys
Users no longer need to expose sensitive private key material over RPC during descriptor imports
reviewability: Code is otherwise ready for review
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Avoids requiring users to handle private keys manually (rkrux)
Already uses a version of this and plans to adopt the PR (Sjors)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because users no longer need to expose private keys when importing descriptors
